newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: One dead, three missing in Kazakh gas explosion.
newsitem.headline: One dead, three missing in Kazakh gas explosion.

text.p: One person was killed and three were missing after a gas explosion ripped through an apartment block in the town of Semipalatinsk in eastern Kazakhstan, an official said on Tuesday.
The official, from Kazakhstan's state Committee for Emergency Situations, told Reuters the blast occurred around 1500 (0900 GMT) on Monday and destroyed many of the flats in the building.
Earlier on Tuesday Russia's Interfax news agency put the death toll at five.
